user_flows.flow_name: Coach Flow: Login to Feedback Generation
Teacher Flow: Feedback to Action Planning
user_flows.entry_point: Email notification and Growth Journal access

user_needs: Goal alignment with professional growth objectives
Reflective practices for personal and professional development
pain_points: Difficulty in tracking progress over time
Lack of personalized professional development resources
target_audience.user_demographics: K-12 educational institutions, including public and private schools in the United States.

project_overview.concept_summary: EdCoach AI is an AI-powered instructional coaching platform for K-12 schools that transforms classroom walkthroughs into a continuous growth loop, enabling coaches to conduct rapid observations, generate personalized feedback, and support teacher reflection and growth.
project_overview.problem_statement: Teachers often lack immediate and actionable feedback in professional development, which hinders their growth and the overall effectiveness of instructional practices.
project_overview.solution_approach: Our platform leverages AI to provide targeted feedback based on classroom observations aligned with teacher goals, fostering a supportive environment for continuous improvement.

unique_selling_points: AI-powered feedback tailored to individual teacher goals
Real-time tracking of progress and analytics
competitive_advantages: FERPA compliance and secure data management
Engagement with detailed analytics and growth metrics

primary_features.user_story: As a coach, I want to set clear goals for my teachers so that they can focus on their professional development.
primary_features.description: AI-assisted SMART goal creation aligned with Louisiana Educator Rubric
acceptance_criteria: Coaches can create PGP goals with AI guidance
Goals are trackable within the system

primary_features.user_story: As a coach, I want to conduct quick walkthroughs to capture essential evidence of teaching practices.
primary_features.description: Mobile-friendly evidence collection with rubric indicators
acceptance_criteria: Walkthrough can be completed in under 5 minutes
All evidence collected is tied to the rubric indicators

primary_features.user_story: As a coach, I want AI to generate tailored feedback based on my observations so that I can provide immediate support to teachers.
primary_features.description: GPT-4 powered, context-aware feedback based on teacher goals
acceptance_criteria: Feedback is generated in less than 10 seconds
Feedback is relevant to the specific PGP goal and observation

primary_features.user_story: As a teacher, I want a private space to reflect on feedback and set next steps for improvement.
primary_features.description: Private growth journal with guided prompts
acceptance_criteria: Teachers can answer guided prompts in a secure environment
Reflections are only visible to the teacher and their coach

primary_features.user_story: As a coach, I want to track teacher progress over time to provide tailored support.
primary_features.description: Real-time tracking for coaches and teachers
acceptance_criteria: Dashboards load in under 2 seconds
Progress is visually represented in an easy-to-understand format
